start_time_scope: Observed clock at first execution probe. Initial read-only inspection preceded this timestamp. Original campaign start is unknown.

spending.restriction: Only no-charge public access and local computation. Current agent inference is provided by the harness, not evidence of free or independently callable inference.

filesystem.read: verified through directory listing and delegation-plan read
filesystem.write_authorization: Delegated sole writer token for this task
filesystem.write_probe: Creation of this artifact is the scoped write probe; readback validation follows creation.

foreground_execution.probe: Python standard-library computation, one-second sleep, and two sequential bounded HTTPS requests
foreground_execution.sustained_foreground_execution: Short bounded foreground calls verified. Repeated calls may proceed while the session remains active. Continuous long-duration availability is unverified.

public_browsing.method: Python urllib HTTPS GET without application credentials or purchases
public_browsing.scope: Two public endpoints only. HTTP success does not establish other sites' access, useful research content, or permitted automated bulk collection.

inference.restriction: Do not assume the current assistant session supplies a reproducible callable baseline or authorizes paid model calls. Missing PATH executables do not prove that no local inference capability exists.

restrictions: Preserve existing changes and all eight supplied untracked paths.
Do not inspect secret values or modify harness settings or permissions.
Do not re-derive supplied Git topology, create worktrees, publish, fetch, pull, merge, rebase, stash, clean, hard-reset, or force-update refs.
No detached processes, background jobs, daemon mode, or unattended 24-hour promise. Subprocesses must finish before reporting.
Keep validation commands bounded to at most 60 seconds. Do not scan the filesystem root or home directory or download large datasets.
Do not buy access, call paid APIs, bypass authentication or access controls, or treat a blocked site as permission to evade its restrictions.
Record inaccessible sources and continue through other authorized sources or products without inventing completed research.
All subsequent task reports must end with one FH_TASK_OUTCOME JSON metadata line using schema_version 1 and a truthful allowed status.
handoff: Public-source discovery and local tooling can proceed within these restrictions. Independently callable no-charge inference remains unverified. This assessment is not research completion, prototype acceptance, or evidence of 24 hours of execution.
